name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore's coast, a Beached Sea Turtle lies dead beneath the carriage it once hauled. A box marked with strange runes rests in the wreckage.

sections.title: A Beast of Burden
sections.body: A dead sea turtle lies among the ancient bones scattered along Darkshore's coast. Splintered carriage boards still cling to its broad shell. The turtle was driven onto the rocks while hauling cargo, rather than stranded by sickness or disorientation. A container carved with unfamiliar, serpent-like marks lies in the wreckage, amid scavengers feeding on the remains.

sections.title: The Naga Incursion
sections.body: In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde identifies the box's craftsmanship as naga work. The naga use great sea beasts to carry provisions and weapons ashore during their attacks from the water. The wreck lies along Darkshore's southern shore, and Gwennyth suspects the turtle was carrying supplies toward Ashenvale. Its end may point to the naga reaching farther across northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why does this sea turtle have a carriage on its back?
faq.answer: The naga fitted the carriage to the turtle and used giant sea turtles as living pack animals, carrying supplies, weapons, and war materiel from the ocean depths onto land.

faq.q: Who is currently inhabiting the remains?
faq.answer: Powerful Greymist murlocs have taken over the giant shell since the turtle died, using its hollowed-out remains as a fortified seaside shelter.

faq.q: Where does the Strangely Marked Box go?
aliases: where do i take the box
faq.answer: Bring the box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, an emissary of the Temple of the Moon stationed in Auberdine.

faq.q: What do the markings on the box mean?
faq.answer: The markings are naga script. They show that the box and carriage belonged to a naga supply convoy moving along the coast, likely toward Ashenvale before disaster struck.

faq.q: Why is the Temple of the Moon interested in beached turtles?
faq.answer: The priestesses of Elune are investigating threats to Darkshore's coast, both environmental and military. Recovered artifacts like this box go to Darnassus, where scholars can map hostile movements.

faq.q: Where was the turtle traveling before it died?
faq.answer: From the carcass's location along the coast, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde suspects the naga were directing the laden turtle south, possibly toward Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you know the naga's use of sea life to carry supplies for war is an outrage to the kaldorei. These tracks help the Temple of the Moon follow threats toward Ashenvale.
As a Druid, you see a noble sea turtle forced to carry weapons of war, then left to rot among scavengers. The naga show little regard for wild beasts.
As an Alliance member, you help alert Auberdine and Darnassus to naga supply routes that threaten northern Kalimdor.
